t: This is the Light House, a house in Hampstead, in NW3, built in the 1980s in the postmodern style. It was designed by Ivan Simovic, who is described as an architect and author. The material I have does not say more about the house, so I will not invent details. What you can do is look at it as a product of its decade. Postmodern architecture of the 1980s often played with form and reference, and this house is a London example.
